name: Codex Security
description: Finds, validates and patches code vulnerabilities in repositories and Git changes, from the cs CLI, a TypeScript SDK, a GitHub Action or Codex.

skills.name: Scan repositories
skills.description: Scans whole repositories, selected paths or Git changes for vulnerabilities and returns deduplicated findings.

skills.name: Validate and patch findings
skills.description: Validates candidate findings, generates patches for them and verifies that existing fixes hold.

skills.name: Threat models and policies
skills.description: Drafts SECURITY.md policies and saves threat models of a project for later security review.
